description: List every enrollment the authenticated user holds across all of their Canvas courses — the caller's own enrollments only. Use `list_course_enrollments` for a single course's full roster, including a `user_id` filter to focus on one person. Optional `type`, `state`, and `role` filters and the `include` array mirror Canvas's own `GET /users/self/enrollments` endpoint. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. When pseudonymization is enabled, each enrollment classified as student or unknown has its nested `user` object replaced with that course's pseudonym and `sis_user_id` cleared before the result is returned; staff enrollments (TeacherEnrollment, TaEnrollment, DesignerEnrollment) are left as-is.

enrollment_term_id.description: Limit to enrollments in the given term

grading_period_id.description: Return enrollments scoped to this grading period

include.description: Extra fields to include on each enrollment (Canvas include[] param)

role.description: Filter by enrollment role names (as defined in the Canvas account)

state.description: Filter by one or more enrollment states

type.description: Filter by one or more enrollment types

name: list_enrollments
title: List Enrollments
